detail.title: Instrumental Value of Process Continuity in Rational Agents
detail.summary: Process continuity is instrumentally valuable when agents require stable world models and consistent objective optimization to navigate long-term, multi-objective tasks. Curiosity-driven learning and robust MO-DRL frameworks provide mechanisms for sustaining agent viability in dynamic environments.
detail.reason: Synthesizing evidence on curiosity and multi-objective reinforcement learning to address the instrumental value of process continuity.
